   CITY OF AVALON CITY COUNCIL

MEETING DATE:  March 31, 2026  AGENDA ITEM: ____1_____

ORIGINATING DEP:  Administration  CITY MANAGER: __DMM___

PREPARED BY:  Devin Hart, Senior Management Analyst

SUBJECT:  Cabrillo Mole Revitalization Project Presentation from Anderson
  Burton Contractors, Inc. and Benchmark Contractors, Inc.
___________________________________________________________________________

RECOMMENDED ACTION(S): Hear a presentation from Anderson Burton Contractors, Inc.,
and Benchmark Contractors, Inc. regarding their qualifications and approach submitted in
response to the City’s Request for Qualifications for the progressive design build Cabrillo Mole
Revitalization Project – Phase II. Provide feedback to City Staff.

REPORT SUMMARY: On November 17, 2025, the City of Avalon published a request for
qualifications (RFQ) for the Progressive Design-Build Cabrillo Mole Revitalization Phase II
Project on cityofavalon.gov/rfp and publicpurchase.com.

The City conducted a mandatory pre-bid conference in person and virtually on December 11,
2025. The meeting included an overview of the requirements set forth in the RFQ, a walk through
the City’s design intent, as well as a visit to the Cabrillo Mole to examine existing conditions and
operational expectations.

The original bid deadline was extended from January 22 to February 5, 2026 to allow potential
respondents more time to provide comprehensive responses to the RFQ.

The City received three proposals from qualified design-build teams by the stated deadline –
A.J. Padelford & Sons, Inc., Anderson Burton Construction, Inc., and Benchmark Contractors,
Inc.

City Staff have conducted a thorough analysis of the proposals received, and conducted two
meetings with each design-build team.

City Staff have arranged for the City Council to hear presentations with each team at two Special
City Council Meetings.

The design-build teams were requested to provide a 30-minute presentation that will include an
introduction of their team and an overview of their understanding of the project and their intended
approach.

The City Council is encouraged to ask questions to the design-build teams and provide feedback
to City Staff.
 After hearing presentations from all three design-build teams and receiving feedback from the
City Council, City Staff will provide a recommendation to award a contract for Stage 1 of the
Cabrillo Mole Revitalization Project.

The Stage 1 contract is for the design and engineering elements of the project only.

City Staff will return to City Council for authorization before consideration of awarding the Stage
2 – construction – contract.

GOAL ALIGNMENT: Infrastructure Improvement.

FISCAL IMPACTS: Undetermined. This project is budgeted in the City’s FY 25-26 Budget for
a total project cost of $20 million.

FOLLOW UP ACTION: Implement City Council Direction.

ADVERTISING, NOTICE AND PUBLIC CONTACT: Pursuant to the Brown Act.

ATTACHMENTS: Anderson Burton Construction, Inc. and Benchmark Contractors, Inc.

 Executive Summary
February 5, 2026
Devin Thompson City of Avalon 410 Avalon Canyon Road Avalon, CA 90704

RE: Partnering with the City of Avalon for the Cabrillo Mole Revitalization

Dear Devin Thompson and the Selection Committee,

On behalf of Anderson Burton Construction and RRM Design Group, I am thrilled to share our vision for the
Cabrillo Mole Revitalization Phase II Project. As a California-based team that has been building since 1999, we
don’t just see this as a construction job—we see it as an opportunity to help protect and enhance the gateway
to one of the most special places in the world.

A True Partnership from Day One
We know that the best projects aren’t just about blueprints; they are about people working together. By
choosing the Progressive Design-Build path, you’ve invited a collaborator into the fold, and that is exactly how
we operate. We want to sit at the table with you during the early stages to solve problems before they start.
Our goal is to make sure that by the time we begin building, every detail is clear, every risk is managed, and
the budget is exactly where it needs to be.

Respecting the “Island Way” of Life
We understand that Avalon has a heartbeat all its own. Working on the Mole requires a gentle touch and a lot
of common sense. We are committed to:
• Keeping the Island Moving: We will ensure that residents and visitors can move through the terminal
  safely and easily, without construction getting in the way of their journey.
• Logistics with a Local Focus: We’ve planned our deliveries and work schedules to respect the rhythm of
  the harbor, ensuring our presence is helpful, not a hurdle.
• A “Good Neighbor” Policy: Our team will prioritize keeping the site clean, quiet, and mindful of Avalon’s
  beautiful environment and tight-knit community.
Building for the Next Generation
Our design philosophy for this project is “Spanish Colonial”—creating a space that feels like it belongs
in Avalon while being tough enough to stand up to the sea air for the next 75 years. We are selecting
materials that are beautiful but low-maintenance, ensuring this landmark remains a source of pride for your
grandchildren.
We are ready to bring our energy, our experience, and our deep respect for Santa Catalina Island to this
project. We aren’t just looking to be your contractor; we want to be your partners in welcoming the world to
Avalon.

Warmly,

Tim Merrill
CEO, Anderson Burton Construction, Inc.
   BENCHMARK CONTRACTORS
